data.title: First reminder: Muster Magazin annual fee
data.summary: Muster Verlag GmbH sent a first reminder (1. Mahnung) on 13 June 2025 for the unpaid annual fee of the "Muster Magazin" subscription. The total due is €61.90, payable by 30 June 2025.
data.explanation: The publisher says your annual subscription fee of €59.40 is still unpaid and has added a €2.50 reminder fee. Please transfer €61.90 to the account named in the letter by 30 June 2025. If you have already paid, you can ignore the letter. If you think the claim is wrong, contact the publisher's customer service (Leserservice). The letter does not say what happens if you miss the date, but further reminders or costs are possible.
